title: great product at a good price.
text: great product at a good price.. This is my first spiralizer. When I first set it up,I thought I read the instructions correctly, but the zucchini kept turning and falling off near the blade. I got frustrated and wanted to send it back as junk. However, thinking I must have missed something, I read the ins. again slower, and more carefully, turns out the metal tube near the blade is where the end of the zuc.is supposed to go to hold it in place. I pushed it on and started to turn the handle and  IT WORKED..LOL after I got that figured out and completed spiralizing my zuc into the noodle shape, I was hooked! it is easy to use and clean. now I am in love with it..its a good machine for the price and it gets the job done..
